title: 第九章 大难将至
content_zh:
“道祖!这是怎么回事?”玉皇大帝传音道。

    此时一向居高临下高高在上的玉皇大帝却惊恐万分，而他的脸上更显露出无尽的恐惧与慌张。

    “我怎么知道!你个废物竟然把宝贵的显劫石用坏了”鸿钧怒声喝道。

    那玉皇大帝满是冤枉，明明什么都没有做却被鸿钧道祖骂的狗血淋头。

    “不过怎么可能出现两个量劫，就算出现，出两个小的量劫也就罢了，可两个如此厉害的量劫竟然同时出现了”

    “请问道祖，在下不知两个量劫是何意义”玉皇大帝问道。

    “那神魔量劫之前也是听说过的，此量劫如它的名字一样，就是这个洪荒世界的神仙乃至妖魔都会被卷入这场量劫当中，而且非常不可控，搞不好会发生浩劫!不过前几次神魔量劫都是对魔道产生了危害，估计这次也一样吧”

    “那三重天雷劫呢，三重天雷劫可有记载”

    “那个传说吗?按理来说那只是个传说而已，可是显劫石不可能出错啊”鸿钧喃喃自语道。

    “传说那三重天雷劫乃是一个人渡劫天赋的体现，传说只有在一次渡劫中连续经历三九雷劫，六九雷劫，以及九九雷劫的洗礼，而且这九九雷劫必须是那传说中的黑雷劫才有可能触发这三重天雷劫，不过那可是传说啊”

    “竟然是有人渡劫触发的这个劫难，此人并非等闲之辈，乃是万中无一的绝世天才啊!”玉皇大帝满脸惊叹道。

    ……

    与此同时，李磊刚刚渡完劫不一会就醒了。

    “这就是人仙的力量吗”李磊兴奋的打量着自己的每一点变化。

    成为人仙乃是正式踏入成仙之道的第一步，可紧紧是这第一步却难倒无数英雄好汉。

    仙人境界分为:人仙、地仙、天仙、真仙、太乙真仙、大罗真仙、金仙、太乙金仙、大罗金仙。
content_en:
"Tao Ancestor! What's going on?" the Jade Emperor said in a message.

    At this time, the Jade Emperor, who had always been condescending and aloof, was horrified, and his face showed endless fear and panic.

    "How do I know! You waste, you actually used up the precious calamity manifesting stone," Hongjun shouted angrily.

    The Jade Emperor was full of injustice. He was scolded by Hongjun Daozu even though he did nothing.

    "But how could two calamities appear? Even if they did, it would only be two small calamities. But two such powerful calamities actually appeared at the same time."

    "Excuse me, Taozu, I don't know what the two calamities mean," the Jade Emperor asked.

    "I have heard of the calamity of gods and demons before. This calamity is just like its name. The gods and even demons in this prehistoric world will be involved in this calamity, and it is very uncontrollable. A catastrophe may occur! However, the previous calamities of gods and demons have caused harm to the devil, and it is probably the same this time."

    "What about the third level of thunder tribulation? Is there any record of the third level of thunder tribulation?"

    "That legend? Logically speaking, it's just a legend, but the calamity stone cannot be wrong," Hongjun murmured to himself.

    "Legend has it that the third level of thunder tribulation is the manifestation of a person's talent for overcoming tribulations. Legend has it that only by experiencing the baptism of three nine thunder tribulations, six nine thunder tribulations, and ninety-nine thunder tribulations in one tribulation, and the ninety-nine thunder tribulations must be the legendary black thunder tribulation can it be possible to trigger the three levels of heaven's thunder tribulation, but that is a legend."

    "It turned out that someone had transcended the tribulation and triggered this catastrophe. This person is not an ordinary person, but a unique genius!" The Jade Emperor exclaimed in amazement.

    …

    At the same time, Li Lei woke up shortly after surviving the tribulation.

    "Is this the power of immortals?" Li Lei looked at every change in himself excitedly.

    Becoming an immortal is the first step on the road to becoming an immortal, but this first step has stumped countless heroes.

    The realm of immortals is divided into: human immortals, earth immortals, heavenly immortals, true immortals, Taiyi true immortals, Daluo true immortals, golden immortals, Taiyi golden immortals, and Daluo golden immortals.
